> [!summary] Data available

## Foods & dishes
- [[WorldCuisines]]: 1 dish (koba); no other food dataset covers Madagascar.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national FCT is in the vault or `Backlog/`. The [[FAO INFOODS global databases]] candidate (priority 2, directory of 308 tables) is where a national or regional table would be found. Fallback: [[USDA FoodData Central]] by name matching.
- [[CMAUP]]: 138 plants; [[NPASS]]: **188 pairs from 31 species**, the most diverse NPASS sampling in Sub-Saharan Africa.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]]: 94 ethnobotany records (55 taxa).
- [[KNApSAcK Family]] lists Madagascar on its World map, but African flag pages were not scraped (counts unknown).
- Compound → effect chains come from the global backbone via [[Global]] ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[SpiceRx]], [[DDID]] for food–drug interactions).

## Gaps
- No Malagasy dishes (romazava, ravitoto) beyond one; no FCT.
- Endemic medicinal flora is covered as compounds, not as traditional use.
